app.title: DVN Admin
app.unreachable: Cannot connect: {error}. Make sure the service is running, then reload.
app.onlyVideoNode: This page is only available on a Video Node.
login.title: Admin sign-in
login.hint1: The first admin password is shown once in the service log. You can change it in Settings after signing in.
login.hint2: Your sign-in is extended while you use the app. You will need to sign in again after a long idle period or the maximum lifetime.
overview.startIntro: Register a video directory, then import files from it.
diagnostics.imageBuildMissing: Not provided (version metadata was not written during the build)
monitor.intro: CPU and traffic rates are sampled every two seconds, and more often while video jobs are active. They cover this DVN service process; in Docker they are not host-wide totals. CPU excludes FFprobe subprocesses, and memory is the Go runtime rather than the whole process or container.
monitor.updateFailed: Update failed: {error}. The last successful data remains below while retrying.
monitor.uptime: Uptime {duration} · logical CPUs {cpus} · Go max procs {maxProcs} · last data {received}
monitor.cpuNote: One fully used core is 100%; multiple cores can exceed 100%.
monitor.httpSummary: In flight {inFlight} · {rps} completed/s · {requests} total completed · {errors} 5xx responses
monitor.httpNote: Counts only HTTP bodies read and written by this service, including playback, health checks, and monitoring. It is not all network-interface traffic; counters reset when the service restarts.
monitor.noActiveJobs: No video jobs are running or waiting.
monitor.queueNote: Queue-wide counts; shows running jobs and the earliest waiting jobs first, up to 10.
monitor.backfillWaitingQueue: Queue is busy; scheduling waits until it becomes idle
monitor.backfillLimitReached: Daily backfill limit reached; resets at {time}
monitor.backfillResetConfirm: Reset today's automatic backfill usage? This only restores the daily budget; other settings and videos are not affected.
monitor.backfillResetDone: Today's automatic backfill usage has been reset.
monitor.scanLast: Last completed {time} · jobs added {enqueued} · waiting for stability {pending} · changed {changed} · missing {deleted} · failed {failed} · offline pools {offline}
monitor.backgroundUnavailable: This service does not implement dispatch or federation sync yet, so there are no background jobs to show.
jobProgress.unknown: Checking video metadata; no reliable percentage yet
importJobs.title: Video background jobs
importJobs.intro1: Shows the latest 100 import and metadata jobs; unfinished jobs resume after a restart. One video is processed at a time to avoid heavy concurrent disk reads.
importJobs.intro2: Updates every 0.5 seconds while jobs are active and every 2 seconds when idle. The list is sorted by newest creation; execution follows creation order and continues with the next job as soon as one finishes.
importJobs.nextBackfill: Next backfill check in about {duration} · {count} candidates
importJobs.updateFailed: Update failed: {error}. The last successful data remains while retrying.
filters.title: Title
metadata.title: Video title
metadata.titlePlaceholder: Uses the file name by default
metadata.tagsHint: Up to 20 tags, 40 characters each; whitespace and duplicates are removed on save.
metadata.creatorNote: Creators and the importer are recorded separately. A repost needs the creator and either the original source or a pending marker.
metadata.creator: Creator {index}
metadata.sourceUrlPlaceholder: URL of the original video page
metadata.sourcePending: Source pending (original work URL not found)
metadata.repostNotePlaceholder: e.g. translation, editing, or permission obtained
metadata.licensePlaceholder: e.g. All rights reserved, CC BY 4.0
metadata.legalNote: Citing a repost source does not grant a license. An empty license means it was not provided. 18+ is currently only a flag.
library.noMatches: No videos match the filters. Adjust or clear them.
library.poolsIntro: Register existing directories on the server; original files stay in place.
library.scanAutoOn: Automatic check is on; hot pools scan every {duration}.
library.scanAutoOff: Automatic check is off; you can scan manually.
library.scanStable: New files must remain stable for at least {duration} before import.
library.scanBackoff: Tiered scan: hot {hot}, warm 1–6h 5m, 6–24h 15m, cold 30m, dormant {dormant}.
library.scanLast: Last completed: {time} · queued imports {enqueued} · waiting for stability {pending} · changed {changed} · missing {deleted} · failed {failed} · offline pools {offline}
library.noPools: No storage pools are registered. Add the directory that contains your videos.
library.addPoolIntro: Register a new video directory; you can then add videos by scanning or manual import.
library.importIntro: After adding it to the background queue, the service probes the video and then computes SHA-256. Original files stay in place; follow progress in Video jobs.
library.metadataIntro: Automatic import uses the file name as the title and keeps the work type as Not confirmed; you can fill in the rest later in the library.
library.playerNote: This stage plays the original file directly. Playback depends on codecs supported by the browser; automatic transcoding is not available yet.
settings.title: Settings
settings.fallbackPlaceholder: Comma-separated; leave empty to disable fallback
settings.rememberPort: Prefer the last successful port on next start
settings.rememberHint: At least one fallback port is required; this stays disabled for fixed Docker container ports.
settings.scanIdleMaxHint: Used after 7 days without changes; default 6 hours, up to 24 hours.
settings.autoBackfillHint: Off by default; schedules one video only when the queue is idle, subject to the SHA-256 read limit.
settings.overrideResetHint: Clears only overrides written from this page; the baseline file {base} is not modified, and videos, pools, or backfill usage are unaffected.
settings.resetConfirm: Delete {override} and return all page-managed settings to the baseline file {base}? This does not affect today's backfill usage, videos, or pools.
settings.dirsReadOnly: Data and web directories are read-only here and cannot be changed from the admin page.
settings.restarting: Restarting; waiting for the service to come back…
settings.restartRequired: Saved settings are waiting to be applied.
settings.restartNotRequired: The running values match the saved settings.
settings.restartWarning: Restarting interrupts in-flight requests. If you changed the listen address or port, open the new address afterwards.
settings.restartConfirm: Restart the service and apply the saved settings?
settings.noticeSavedRestart: Settings saved. Restart the service to apply them.
settings.noticeSavedSame: Settings saved; they match the running values.
settings.noticeResetRestart: Overrides removed. Restart the service to apply the baseline.
settings.noticePassword: Admin password updated. Sign-ins on other devices are no longer valid.
settings.errPreferredPort: Preferred port must be an integer from 1 to 65535
settings.errScanInterval: Scan interval must be an integer from 1 to 86400
settings.errFileStable: File stable time must be an integer from 1 to 86400
settings.errScanIdleMax: Dormant scan interval must be an integer from 1800 to 86400
settings.errBackfillInterval: Backfill check interval must be an integer from 10 to 86400
settings.errHashLimit: SHA-256 read limit must be an integer from 0 to 102400
settings.errBackfillDailyLimit: Daily backfill video limit must be an integer from 0 to 100000
settings.errBackfillDailyGiB: Daily backfill size limit must be an integer from 0 to 102400 GiB
settings.errRestartTimeout: The service did not recover within 30 seconds. Check the logs or start it manually.
settings.errNewPasswordLength: The new password must be at least 12 characters
settings.errPasswordMismatch: The new passwords do not match
apiDocs.title: API reference and console
apiDocs.intro: Uses your current admin session; no separate authorization is needed. The docs and console target the service you are using.
apiDocs.step1: Expand a tag and API to see its description, required parameters, and response format.
apiDocs.step2: Click Try it out, fill in parameters, or edit the JSON example.
apiDocs.step3: Click Execute to see the status code, response body, and curl example.
apiDocs.warning: Execute performs real operations on this service; imports, settings, password changes, and restarts take effect. Replace the sample pool/video/job IDs with your own data. The version header defaults to 1; change it to test incompatible responses.
apiDocs.curlNote: Generated curl examples do not include the browser's HttpOnly cookie. To run them in a terminal, sign in and use your own cookie file.
apiDocs.onlySameOrigin: This console can only call APIs on the current service
settings.liveChanged: Settings changed in another tab; this form has unsaved edits.
library.scanExcludeSystemHint: Turning this off scans system, program, cache, and hidden folders; only disable for an intentional whole-disk scan.
library.wholeDiskWarning: This is a disk root; a full scan may include many system, cache, or game videos.
library.scanExcludeSystemConfirm: Disabling system-folder exclusions scans Windows, Program Files, AppData, hidden folders, and caches. Enable whole-disk scanning?
discovered.title: Discovered videos
discovered.intro: Files found by index-only pool scans that are not in the library yet. Select files to import; SHA-256 and FFprobe run only after import.
library.indexOnlyHint: Scans record path and size without SHA-256/FFprobe; import manually from Discovered. Turning it off keeps existing discovered files manual; only new files auto-import.
discovered.remoteImportUnavailable: WebDAV pools currently support indexing only; import is not available.
discovered.playerNote: Video is proxied from OpenList WebDAV by DVN; credentials are not sent to the browser.
